note: Application menu bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for application commands (File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Styles, Table, Tools, Window, Help) and their sub-items
Application toolbars -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for standard editing and formatting controls (Undo, Redo, Cut, Copy, Paste, Bold, Italic, etc.)
Application status bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for document state indicators (Page, Word Count, Zoom, Language, etc.)
